Pathweft's media preview uses selected libmpv client API/native-window integration
with the runtime built from Darkaxt/vlc tag redesign-v1.1.1, commit
b84e7326e3d3e554120f3866fbe1c1acfa5ec6cc. The native-window gpu-next approach is
also used by Darkaxt/NuvioDesktopDV. No Qt/Kotlin player interface is imported.

mpv contributors: GPL-2.0-or-later; the linked FFmpeg build is GPL/version3.
libplacebo and every linked dependency retain their original terms. Complete
original selected notices are distributed in MPV/licenses, with their verified
source archive identities in its manifest. See runtime-manifest.json and the
donor's MPV-BUILDINFO.json for exact revisions, build recipes and native hashes.

The matching dependency-source release includes full pinned native sources,
the donor's build recipe, WASAPI session patch, SDK contrib recipes and runtime
sources. Reproduce/import using scripts/Prepare-MpvDependency.py. Compatible
replacement shared libraries are permitted; Pathweft does not signature-lock
the native runtime. Do not omit original notices or corresponding source.

Preview output is GPU-rendered BT.709/sRGB SDR, including Dolby Vision metadata
mapping. Native Dolby Vision display signaling and full Profile7 FEL are not
claimed. The F3D runtime has a separate FFmpeg build and its own notices.
